name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: PROACTIVE-ONLY BUILD (v0.6.2): same three-trigger architecture and email-address filter as v0.6.1 (1. compose-window-open -> unconditional CertVerifier rebuild; 2. send button/menu intercepted before the real send -> duplicate-only cleanup, no reinit, original send runs exactly once; 3. shutdown -> duplicate-only cleanup; no retry), with two fixes: (a) the email-address check is now null-safe -- some nsIX509CertDB cert objects expose no 'emailAddresses' property at all, and the v0.6.1 filter's unchecked cert.emailAddresses.length threw a TypeError that aborted the entire doCleanup() pass on the very first send-button trigger; (b) the hardcoded VERSION string used in every console.log line was still 0.6.0, so 0.6.1 installs logged themselves as 0.6.0 -- the debug version is now bumped in lockstep with manifest.json.
